title: Sequence 6 Activation and Scientific Closure Ingestion

sequence_6_purpose.product_law: THE PRODUCT IS NOT THE DISSERTATION RENDERED AS UI. THE PRODUCT IS THE SURVIVING RELATION SET RENDERED BEAUTIFULLY.
sequence_6_purpose.primary_research_question: How much of the useful architecture survives after bespoke vocabulary, historical mythology, preferred interpretation, and unearned ontology are stripped away?
sequence_6_purpose.secondary_research_question: Which discarded or currently unvalidated structures remain sufficiently generative to deserve new formal study under a clearly speculative evidence class?
